name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Prehled novinek (Release notes) tab
description:
## Why?

Release notes are shown to merchants in the marketplace when an addon updates. One WYSIWYG field per language, sharing the same per-language tab machinery as the Popis tab, so it should follow that task.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/ReleaseNotes.tpl` to React, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partial.

Fields per CRM language: `language[]` (hidden) and `releaseNotes[]` (WYSIWYG).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Nested language tabs render one WYSIWYG panel per CRM language, reusing the component built for the Popis tab
- `releaseNotes[]` round-trips content unchanged, including existing HTML
- Field names in the POST body unchanged; verified against `getUpdatedLanguageFields()`
- Every `data-testid` from `ReleaseNotes.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `ReleaseNotes.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/ReleaseNotes.tpl:11,15`
- Backend: `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceAddController.php:199-211`
- Data: `st_crm.services_lng` (`releaseNotes`)
